result.instructions:
This server controls the illusion game engine editor. Every tool is an editor command.
Workflow: discover (editor_list_commands, editor_describe, scene_tree, component_types), then create (entity_create with Components, component_set, hierarchy_set_parent, transform_set; editor_batch runs several steps as one undo step), save (scene_save), and verify (scene_tree, entity_get, scene_info).
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Angles are radians or {"deg": n}; transform tools also take {"euler": [x, y, z]} in degrees. Quaternions are [x, y, z, w]; colours are linear [r, g, b] or "#rrggbb"; 64-bit integers are decimal strings; asset fields are paths such as "builtin:/mesh/cube".
Entity references: a 16-hex id, a path of names ("/Game/Board"), "name:Board" or "$selection". Results name entities as {id, name, path}.
Mutating tools take dryRun to validate without applying. A failed call returns isError with a code, a kind, the JSON Pointer of the bad parameter, a hint and suggestions. history_undo with {"scope": "mine"} undoes only your own steps.
Read illusion://guide for details and illusion://commands for every command.

tools.name: editor_batch
tools.description:
Runs commands in order as one undo step. Example: {"steps": []}.

Parameters:
- steps (object[], required)
- label (string, optional)

Permission: edit.

tools.name: editor_list_commands
tools.description:
Lists every command. Example: {}.

Permission: read.

tools.name: editor_wait
tools.description:
Asynchronous: answers after the given number of frames. Example: {"frames": 60}.

Parameters:
- frames (integer in [1, 100000], required)

Permission: read. Long-running: reports progress and can be cancelled.

tools.name: entity_create
tools.description:
Creates an entity. Example: {"name": "Board"}.

Parameters:
- name (string, optional)
- parent (string, optional)

Also takes dryRun (validate only), mergeKey, clientToken and expectRevision.

Permission: edit.

tools.name: entity_get
tools.description:
Returns an entity. Example: {"entity": "name:Board"}.

Parameters:
- entity (string, required)

Permission: read.

tools.name: scene_info
tools.description:
Returns the active scene's state. Example: {}.

Permission: read.

tools.name: scene_tree
tools.description:
Returns the entity tree. Example: {}.

Permission: read.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description:
Returns the open project. Example: {}.

Permission: read.

tools.name: component_schema
tools.description:
Returns the JSON Schema of a Component's value. Example: {"type": "illusion.Transform"}.

Parameters:
- type (string, required)

Permission: read.

tools.name: log_read
tools.description:
Returns log messages. Example: {"limit": 50}.

Parameters:
- limit (integer >= 1, optional)

Permission: read.

tools.name: illusion_call
tools.description: Runs any editor command by its method name, including commands not offered as tools. Use editor_list_commands and editor_describe (or illusion://commands) to find them. Example: {"method": "scene.info", "params": {}}.
